items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So there were several musical families here in Los Angeles. There was your family, the McVey family... Is that right? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Just about everything that was happening with Patsy Howard was -- bang, producing and doing all kinds of things.
So there were several musical families here in Los Angeles. There was your family, the McVey family, the Young family, where everybody was involved in music. Is that right?
